schemaVersion.description: Catalog format version. This build reads version 1 and refuses any other.

updatedUtc.description: When the catalog was last edited. Displayed only.

code.description: Pack identifier. Names files on disk, so no path characters, not '.' or '..', not a Windows reserved device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9), and no trailing dot or space. Enforced by the client, not by this schema's pattern.

type.description: One of expansion, game, stuff, kit. Absent or unrecognised values are read as an unknown type, which does not reject the entry.

size.description: Archive length in bytes. Preallocation, the free-space precheck, and the cross-check against the server all use it.

installedSize.description: Extracted size in bytes. Drives the game-directory free-space precheck; falls back to size when absent.

sha256.description: Lowercase or uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the archive.

urls.description: One or more mirrors of the same archive. sha256 validates whichever mirror served the bytes.

installDirs.description: Directory names under the game directory. Defaults to [code]. A pack counts as installed only when all are present. Names files on disk, so no path characters, not '.' or '..', not a Windows reserved device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9), and no trailing dot or space. Enforced by the client, not by this schema's pattern.
